scope: Repair demonstrated word-internal key-prefix false positives and categorize proposal rejection without content leakage; preserve historical requests and all authority boundaries. Prepare dormant third selector only, no spending.
riskAnalysis: The only behavior change narrows an unanchored substring to standalone key-prefix detection. Exact active-key echo remains denied by transport. Fixed diagnostic categories must not retain model text or mutate historical evidence.

threatModel.assets: Provider credentials, immutable source/evidence and historical receipts, workspace authority, pending financial uncertainty.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Decoded untrusted replacement copy to fixed policy diagnostics; fixture-only review roles to trusted owner/CAS activation controller.
threatModel.abuseCases: Disguised key prefixes, markup/URLs/NUL/Bearer replacement, forged diagnostic paths/rules, historical request-hash drift, consumed-authorization reuse.
threatModel.mitigations: Unicode token-boundary key-prefix rule only, unchanged other predicates, closed rule map/static path, exact active-key echo guard, no prompt change, historical five-stage fixture, unchanged owner and spending controls.

rollback: Keep all paid/count flags disabled and approvals revoked. Revert reviewed guard/prompt source only with regenerated release lock; preserve historical records, consumption markers, pending ledger and cleanup compatibility.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Wrong object/fields, noninteger/oversized counts and secret echo fail closed before Responses dispatch.
negativePaths.stale-state: Source/context/request/expiry and authoritative stored approval mismatch deny dispatch.
negativePaths.concurrency: Count dispatch and count recording are one-use existing-CAS operations; duplicate winners cannot occur.
negativePaths.cancellation: Shared owner/task/revoke/lease checks run after counting and before dispatch; whole-operation abort includes count requests.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Bounded abortAdmission retains pending ceilings and reports cleanup uncertainty; no paid retry.
negativePaths.api-outage: Fixed endpoint/redirect:error, bounded response body, deadline and sanitized status/hash diagnostics; no fallback or retry.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Missing count consent/server pricing pin, impersonated roles or substituted workspace/source deny; no model-granted permissions.
negativePaths.spending-limit: At most five count and five Responses dispatches, existing 1USD retained internal ceiling. Unknown counts remain pending/null; known Responses usage separate; no invoice cap claimed.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Successful count alone cannot settle or accept work. Responses usage mismatch leaves pending evidence/reservation; no generated source execution or publication.

defects.rootCause: Unanchored sk- matches benign word endings; generic proposal-denied code hides which trusted predicate matched.
defects.detectionGap: Original tests covered only markup/Bearer/URLs and did not exercise risk-adjusted/task-based or per-rule receipts.
defects.regression: Offline false-positive/adversarial corpus, all five categorized transport failures with immutable usage/cleanup, five CAS stages and five restricted fixture children, actual preserved hosted request-hash compatibility.
defects.historicalPrevention: Keep replacement-copy policy separate from backend authority. Preserve versioned request construction and actual historical readback before any prompt change.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing organization engineering profile/CAS/lifecycle and parent transport only. Ops plan stays a frozen admission manifest; linked organization workflow records actual roles/results/usage.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Official Responses input-token count schema, fixed dedicated OpenAI project, existing task/source evidence and shared authorization CAS.
proactiveReview.threats: Pricing pin must match the authoritative stored approval, not a substituted caller argument; API content never grants authority.
proactiveReview.failureModes: First count/Responses protocol failure, partial usage, cancellation or timeout stops all later stages without paid retry; keep pending uncertainty, revoke exact stored scope even after source/session changes.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Focused native offline transport, unknown-cost accounting, wrongtask/pin/consent, concurrent one-use CAS, delayed UI crossworkspace and origin substitution; actual Redis uncertainty-race integration added for CI.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent QA reproduced false positives and approved narrow repair. Engineering Auditor caught historical prompt-hash incompatibility; prompt change withdrawn and actual preserved hosted five-stage fixture added. Final audit required before publication.
proactiveReview.recovery: Keep all flags/approvals disabled, retain historical accounting and evidence, preserve exact source checkpoint on interruption.
proactiveReview.readiness: No paid execution authorized; dormant third policy alone grants nothing. Exact current qualified release, trusted pins, fresh source-backed task and explicit owner consent remain mandatory.
